objective: Minimize time-to-detection while keeping promotion confidence separated from raw collection speed.
principle: Collect aggressively, promote conservatively. Official/GGPK data can change effective rules; economy/community data can only raise watch priority until crosschecked.

intake_tracks.cadence: 5m pre-launch and launch week; 2m during known patch/hotfix windows
intake_tracks.promotion_power: Can create or supersede patch-note overlays. GGPK still needed for implementation confirmation.

intake_tracks.cadence: 15m around reveal/launch, then daily until week 2
intake_tracks.command: manual or browser capture into season research DB
intake_tracks.promotion_power: Can update league mechanic facts, but not drop rates or economy ranking.

intake_tracks.cadence: event-triggered; poll client file mtime every 2m while game is patching
intake_tracks.promotion_power: Implementation truth for changed rows after table diff. Supersedes patch-note text only for matched entity/stat.
intake_tracks.required_next_automation: Add versioned GGPK snapshot manifest and table diff writer once the 3.29 client extract is available.

intake_tracks.source: Path of Building / pobb.in / local PoB XML parsing
intake_tracks.cadence: 30m first 48h after launch, then 2h while PoB is catching up
intake_tracks.promotion_power: Can confirm whether builds parse and whether interactions are modelled; cannot override GGPK facts.
Can price/rank item access and farming rewards. Cannot validate mechanics by itself.

intake_tracks.source: Bing RSS over Reddit, official forum guides, Maxroll, PoE Vault, Icy Veins
intake_tracks.promotion_power: Can discover build guide candidates and POB links; needs deterministic parsing and source crosscheck before promotion.

intake_tracks.source: User pasted PoB, Discord reports, streamer PoBs, direct sample XML
intake_tracks.cadence: immediate when pasted; batch every 5m during active session
intake_tracks.promotion_power: Fastest practical build evidence, but must remain sample-scoped until multiple sources or live metrics agree.

intake_tracks.source: Recorded map time, death count, atlas points, loot sample, mechanic branch
intake_tracks.cadence: after every 5 to 10 maps for active experiments
intake_tracks.command: manual sample append until tracker UI exists
intake_tracks.promotion_power: Required for farming strategy promotion. Economy price without map-time is not enough.

promotion_gates.name: mechanic_truth
promotion_gates.rule: Mechanic/stat claims need official text plus GGPK row confirmation after client update.

promotion_gates.name: build_viability
promotion_gates.rule: Builds can stay watchlist from one source, but need parseable PoB and at least one real gear/tree sample before promotion.

promotion_gates.name: farming_recommendation
promotion_gates.rule: Farming advice needs reward signal plus run-time/death-rate sample. Price alone is not enough.

promotion_gates.name: community_hype_filter
promotion_gates.rule: Community hype can raise priority, but not final recommendation confidence without deterministic and economy crosschecks.

coach_rules: Always separate detection speed from promotion confidence.
Prefer official/GGPK for mechanics, poe.ninja for access/economy, PoB for model support, and measured maps for farming viability.
If a source is stale beyond its latency target, say which layer is stale instead of hiding uncertainty.
During launch week, ask for or ingest user PoBs/map samples immediately because manual samples can beat public indexes.
